ops.body: Final realproc accounting: G1 live launchd install and G2 sealed-SSH two-host pickup can remain explicitly unexercised where safe isolation is unavailable; final report must distinguish them from the passing in-process Mesh/foreground-process tests. However the realproc handoff also calls out swallowed ErrNotReady/ErrAbsent at install probe and plain kickstart (without -k) during helper upgrade. Those are implementation questions, not merely test-environment gates. Please give each a fix plus focused simulated-installer test, or a precise reason the behavior is intentional/acceptable with the documented user recovery step. Do not silently call known startup/upgrade defects just untested.
